components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forest-filled primary action with compact uppercase utility label.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--forest); color: var(--paper); font: 700 11px/1.2 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background .2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--forest-deep); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: var(--forest-deep); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Unfilled secondary action with a forest border.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid var(--forest); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--forest); font: 700 11px/1.2 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background .2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--sage); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-outline:active { background: var(--sage); }

components.name: Centered Navigation
components.description: Centered editorial links, with a fine underline on the active page.
components.html: ShopAboutContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 4px 0; color: var(--forest-deep); font: 14px/1.4 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color .18s ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ochre); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page]::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--forest); content: ''; }

components.css: .ds-product-card { min-width: 0; color: var(--ink); } .ds-product-card__image { aspect-ratio: .82; overflow: hidden; background: var(--sage); transition: background .18s ease; } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-card__image { background: var(--line); } .ds-product-card__category { margin: 13px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: 9px/1.4 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-product-card h3 { margin: 5px 0; color: var(--forest-deep); font: 400 21px/1.15 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-product-card a { color: var(--forest); font: 700 10px/1.4 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-product-card a:hover { color: var(--ochre); } .ds-product-card a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Homepage Featured Product Card
components.description: Compact bordered paper card with product type, title, localized price, and a circular cart action.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-featured-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #ddd5c2; border-radius: 5px; background: #f8f5ed; color: var(--ink); } .ds-featured-card__image { aspect-ratio: 1.7; background: #eee9dc; } .ds-featured-card__details { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 33px; align-items: center; gap: 2px 6px; padding: 8px 9px 7px; } .ds-featured-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font: 8px/1.4 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-featured-card h3 { margin: 2px 0; color: var(--forest-deep); font: 400 14px/1.15 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-featured-card strong { color: var(--forest); font: 600 11px/1.3 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-featured-card button { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--forest); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--forest); color: var(--paper); cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-featured-card button svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-featured-card button:hover { background: var(--forest-deep); } .ds-featured-card button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-featured-card button:active { transform: scale(.985); }

components.name: Circular Category Tile
components.description: One of five centered image links in the homepage category shelf.
components.css: .ds-category-tile { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 2px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--forest-deep); text-align: center; text-decoration: none; } .ds-category-tile__image { width: 96px; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sage); transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.65,.25,1); } .ds-category-tile:hover .ds-category-tile__image { transform: scale(1.035); } .ds-category-tile__label { padding-top: 6px; font: 14px/1.15 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-category-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ochre); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-benefits { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); background: var(--forest); color: var(--paper); } .ds-benefits article { min-height: 100px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 15px 18px; border-right: 1px solid rgb(245 245 235 / 21%); text-align: center; } .ds-benefits article:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-benefits h3 { margin: 0 0 3px; font: 400 14px/1.3 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-benefits p { margin: 0; color: #d9dfd5; font: 9px/1.35 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-benefits { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-benefits article { min-height: 106px; padding: 12px 7px; } }

narrative.overview:
The storefront pairs warm paper and restrained botanical greens with food photography, clear product information, and a Playfair Display editorial voice. The home page moves from its landscape hero and five circular category images into a left-aligned Best Sellers introduction beside a horizontal product carousel, then a dark benefits band. The wide-desktop carousel presents four compact product cards in its first view. The hero is 240 to 290px tall on desktop and 400 to 470px on mobile.

The implementation is deliberately light on surface effects. Hairline olive-toned borders, open catalog imagery, and tonal backgrounds provide structure; homepage featured cards use a small paper panel as a surface-specific exception. The shared footer uses a compact forest-green field and botanical line art, without the excluded newsletter. Utility and purchase information remains in Arial. Product cards pair type, title, INR-formatted price, and a compact cart control. The local storefront currently labels illustrative copy and imagery as preview content and disables purchases.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream surfaces with deep green text and controls.
Playfair Display for brand and editorial headings; Arial for utility text.
Open catalog cards with a restrained bordered featured-card variant on the homepage.
Centered brand header and responsive four-card home carousel.

rules.name: The Paper-and-Botanical Rule
rules.body: Use cream and green as the dominant field; keep ochre to small markers and status details.

rules.name: The Serif-and-Utility Rule
rules.body: Keep Playfair Display for the wordmark and editorial titles; use Arial for navigation, body copy, prices, and controls.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use background contrast and separators for grouping; do not introduce resting shadows.

dos: Use the CSS variables in src/app/globals.css as the canonical color source.
Preserve the centered wordmark and homepage section order.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for scrolling and transitions.
Label preview imagery and copy; keep purchases disabled in preview mode.
donts: Do not wrap catalog product cards in heavy panels or oversized rounded cards; reserve the small paper panel for the homepage featured-card variant.
Do not treat preview copy or imagery as verified product, ingredient, quality, or shipping claims.
Do not enable checkout in local preview mode.
